IG_USER_ID.description: Your Instagram account number. In the Meta app, it's the number next to your account under Generate access tokens (looks like 17841...).

IG_TOKEN.description: Your Instagram token. In the Meta app, tap Generate token and copy it. Paste it only here.

DASH_PASSWORD.description: Make up a new password for your dashboard (letters, numbers, dashes). Not your Instagram password.
